description: KNa₂(NiO₂)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. K is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.64-3.07 Å. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted edge-sharing NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are two shorter (2.39 Å) and three longer (2.41 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.52 Å. There are two inequivalent Ni sites. In the first Ni site, Ni is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Ni-O bond distances ranging from 1.96-2.00 Å. In the second Ni site, Ni is bonded in a square co-planar geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Ni-O bond distances ranging from 1.81-1.89 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to one K, three Na, and two Ni atoms to form distorted edge-sharing OKNa₃Ni₂ octahedra. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to one K, three Na, and two Ni atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to two equivalent K, two Na, and two Ni atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to two equivalent K, two Na, and two Ni atoms.
